usda-plants.name: USDA, NRCS PLANTS Database
usda-plants.citation: USDA, NRCS. The PLANTS Database. Date unavailable. National Plant Data Team, Greensboro, NC. https://plants.usda.gov.
usda-plants.licenseNote: The approved project data-source plan states that PLANTS information is not copyrighted and may be used freely with citation. Do not bundle photos.
usda-plants.geographicScope: The USDA PLANTS source covers the United States and additional regions. The importer retains lower-48 county or county-equivalent rows for the 38 curated candidate species; ambiguous names remain unresolved with null county FIPS, and uniquely identified non-lower-48 rows are excluded.
usda-plants.spatialResolution: County or county-equivalent, from the official Counties MapServer layer.
usda-plants.coverage: County status comes from the PLANTS Counties layer Symbol. County names are joined to the same plant's Distribution Documentation only when they identify one unique U.S. state/county row and that row is in the lower 48; ambiguous or missing joins stay unresolved. Coverage is limited to records returned for the curated candidate catalog.
usda-plants.uncertainty: A per-record release or observation date, the numeric plant_nativity_id code domain, and the current endpoint reuse terms were not verified in this worktree. Retrieval time is recorded per claim. Nativity is read from the published county Symbol text; the numeric ID is retained as opaque provenance. The approved project source plan permits cited PLANTS facts and excludes images. Regional profile status is not county evidence. Both, Excluded, Unknown, and unresolved FIPS joins are not affirmative.

bonap-napa.name: BONAP North American Plant Atlas (NAPA)
bonap-napa.citation: BONAP. North American Plant Atlas (NAPA), Echinacea county page: https://bonap.net/Napa/Genus/Traditional/County/Echinacea; sample county map: https://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Echinacea.png; TDC FullTaxonList: https://bonap.net/TDC/Query/FullTaxonList; SpeciesList: https://bonap.net/TDC/Query/SpeciesList; TaxonDetails: https://bonap.net/TDC/Query/TaxonDetails; citation page: http://bonap.org/citation.html. The MapKey page was examined, but its URL was not included in the source-check record. Source check dated 2026-10-01.
bonap-napa.ownerAuthorizationNote: The project owner confirms that BONAP's required advance written permission for bundling has been obtained for this project. This authorization is separate from the source terms and does not itself establish that a taxon-to-map conversion is ready to support a claim.
bonap-napa.licenseNote: BONAP's citation page requires advance written permission for reproduction; the project owner confirms this permission for the project. Map currency, map conversion, taxon matching, and geographic completeness are separate evidence requirements.
bonap-napa.geographicScope: North American Plant Atlas; coverage of all 48 contiguous states for the taxa and evidence routes used by this project is unknown.
bonap-napa.spatialResolution: NAPA's per-taxon map images show county status. Species-level use can be unresolved where a map combines infraspecific taxa. TDC TaxonDetails reports county occurrences, not county nativity.
bonap-napa.coverage: TDC FullTaxonList returns an approximately 1.4 MB UTF-8 TSV, cited 2014. POST TDC SpeciesList returns JSON and accepts county FIPS; the Hennepin County FIPS 27053 probe returned 1,479 taxa. POST TDC TaxonDetails returns a profile and verified county occurrence maps. These TDC results support taxon identity and occurrence discovery, not county native status. Stable taxon IDs, update markers, map coverage, and lower-48 taxon coverage are unknown.
bonap-napa.uncertainty: The observed MapKey defines county fills: dark olive-green Native, orange Native Historic, teal Adventive, and dark navy Exotic. The dark-green continental background means native to North America only; a county may be Adventive even where the background is native. Only a taxonomy-matched county category exactly Native may support affirmative nativity. Preserve other raw categories without affirmative inference; `rare` was reported in the prior source check, but its exact MapKey meaning is unverified. Species maps may conflate infraspecific taxa. The sample Echinacea map says generated 2014-12-14, its HTTP Last-Modified is in 2017, and the NAPA index says last updated 2014-12-15; these dates do not establish current map freshness. Poll ETag, Last-Modified, and content and report the map's own generation date. The map-to-record conversion and its review process are not yet established.

npin.name: Native Plant Information Network
npin.citation: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center. NPIN plants page: https://www.wildflower.org/plants/; WordPress page API: https://www.wildflower.org/wp-json/wp/v2/pages?slug=plants-main; public autocomplete: https://www.wildflower.org/plants/autocomplete-data.php?q=...; Data Use Policy: https://www.wildflower.org/plants-main/image-use-policy. Source check dated 2026-10-01.
npin.ownerAuthorizationNote: The project owner separately confirms permission for this project to scrape NPIN data. This project authorization is distinct from the published source policy and does not permit bypassing access controls.
npin.licenseNote: The published Data Use Policy allows non-commercial data use with attribution and prohibits commercial use. The project owner separately confirms permission for this project. This does not authorize bypassing access controls or extend image rights beyond the policy.
npin.geographicScope: Unknown for any ingestible NPIN profile dataset; lower-48 coverage has not been established.
npin.spatialResolution: The autocomplete response provides common name, scientific name, genus, and ID only; it has no range geography. Profile range-field meanings and resolution are unknown.
npin.coverage: The WordPress REST page at slug plants-main exposes /plants/autocomplete-data.php?q=... for a taxon crosswalk. Its JSON has common name, scientific name, genus, and ID only. This is not an occurrence or range dataset. No accessible profile-data workflow or export is verified; the inspected /plants profile route returned a Cloudflare challenge.
npin.uncertainty: Taxon crosswalk coverage, stable ID behavior, update markers, profile field meanings, range coverage, and county-or-finer resolution are unknown. Do not bypass the Cloudflare challenge. Use the autocomplete endpoint only for the fields it returns, and do not claim an export or profile scrape route until an official or permission-supported accessible workflow is verified.

census-zcta-county.name: 2010 ZCTA-county relationship and 2021 county gazetteer
census-zcta-county.citation: U.S. Census Bureau. 2010 ZCTA-county relationship file; U.S. Census Bureau. 2021 County Gazetteer Files.
census-zcta-county.licenseNote: U.S. government public data; public domain. Cite the Census Bureau.
census-zcta-county.geographicScope: United States ZCTAs and counties; the bundled ZIP-county table includes lower-48 and non-lower-48 records.
census-zcta-county.spatialResolution: All 2010 Census county intersections per ZCTA; the maximum-ZPOPPCT county remains the primary display overlay.
census-zcta-county.coverage: The lower-48 bundle includes 32,604 ZCTAs and all county intersections present in the Census 2010 relationship file. The report distinguishes 32,597 ZCTAs with a named primary county and lists county-name metadata gaps separately.
census-zcta-county.uncertainty: The relationship file uses 2010 county FIPS, while the bundled county names use the 2021 gazetteer. Nine ZCTA intersections carry 2010 county FIPS 46113, which has no name in the 2021 gazetteer; a separate Virginia intersection at 51515 is also unnamed. The gazetteer contains Oglala Lakota County as 46102, but no cross-vintage FIPS is inferred.

census-zcta-centroids.name: Census ZCTA centroid gazetteer
census-zcta-centroids.citation: U.S. Census Bureau. ZCTA Gazetteer / centroid data. Release date unavailable in the bundled ecoregion provenance.
census-zcta-centroids.licenseNote: U.S. government public data; public domain. Cite the Census Bureau.
census-zcta-centroids.geographicScope: U.S. Census ZIP Code Tabulation Areas used by the bundled EPA ecoregion mapping.
census-zcta-centroids.coverage: The bundled EPA mapping resolves 32,537 of 32,604 lower-48 ZCTAs to an ecoregion.
census-zcta-centroids.uncertainty: Centroid assignment can miss within-ZCTA ecoregion boundaries; release and retrieval dates are unknown.

epa-level-iii.name: Level III Ecoregions of the Continental United States
epa-level-iii.citation: U.S. EPA. Level III and IV Ecoregions of the Continental United States (2013 layer, per bundled data provenance).
epa-level-iii.licenseNote: U.S. government public data; public domain. Cite the EPA.
epa-level-iii.geographicScope: Continental United States EPA Level III ecoregions.
epa-level-iii.spatialResolution: Level III ecoregion assigned from a ZCTA centroid point.
epa-level-iii.coverage: 32,537 of 32,604 lower-48 ZCTAs resolve to an EPA Level III ecoregion in the current bundle; 67 have no match.
epa-level-iii.uncertainty: An ecoregion match is contextual catalog coverage, not species-level local nativity evidence; 67 lower-48 ZCTAs have no match.
